# event-log

## Architecture

A distributed append only event log partitions streams across brokers. Consumers track offsets and replay durable messages after failures. The system supports stream processing, replication and ordered delivery for event driven services.

# graph-planner

## Architecture

Models workflow steps as nodes in a directed acyclic graph. The scheduler resolves dependencies, detects cycles and dispatches ready tasks to workers. Developers can retry failed steps and inspect execution graphs for data pipelines.
